item.title: Special Meeting To Review Wildlife Study
item.description: A special meeting of the Chillicothe Airport Advisory Board will be held on Thursday, December 18th at the Airport Terminal Building. The meeting will start at 5:15 pm and is for the discussion of the Wildlife study prepared for the Airport. This is a public meeting.

item.title: Special Session Planned For Chillicothe City Council
item.description: The Chillicothe City Council will have a special CLOSED Executive Session meeting on Tuesday, December 16th. The meeting will be held at Chillicothe City Hall at 4:00 pm to handle contract negotiations. This meeting is NOT open to the public.
